headline: EUROPEAN LANDER SETS DOWN ON COMET
dispatch: DARMSTADT, Nov. 13. The European Space Agency reported that its small lander Philae reached the surface of a comet after separating from the Rosetta spacecraft. The probe, carried through space for a decade, sent back confirmation of the first attempted landing by a spacecraft on such a body.
answer: Philae makes the first landing on a comet, 2014
